decision.summary: Close the PSR-01B program before Validation. Release the protected BTCUSDT 2022-01-01+ intervals for new, separately registered research, and record that they can no longer serve as clean PSR-01B holdouts.

development.interpretation: Beat its registered baseline; underperformed buy-and-hold in both arms; not an exact paper replication; Development-period evidence only, not Validation or out-of-sample evidence.

validation.verification_notes: Checked 2026-09-28: no tag or branch matching the Validation claim exists on origin, and the repository's Actions history shows no run of a PSR-01B Validation execution workflow. Push-triggered 'PSR-01B Validation Bounded Engineering' runs (job name synthetic-offline) exist; their data access was not re-audited for this record.

consequences: No PSR-01B Validation result exists. No validated, out-of-sample or tradable performance claim may be made for PSR-01B.
BTCUSDT data from 2022-01-01 onward may be used by new, separately registered research.
No PSR-01B-family registration (renamed, successor, retry or rescue) may present the released periods as untouched confirmatory Validation or OOS evidence; any such use is exploratory only.
Existing Development evidence, certifications, claim tags, anchors and rulesets remain as historical record and are not modified or deleted.
Existing safety rulesets (including the Validation claim lock) stay active so that no claim can be created that might be misread as a real Validation run.
This closeout authorizes no trading, leverage or derivatives.
